content: व्यवधा €3 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To place between, interpose, intervene; प्रेक्ष्य स्थितां सहचरीं व्यवधाय देहम् <ls>R. 9. 57</ls>. .²2 To hide, conceal, screen; शापव्यवहितस्मृतिः <ls>Ś. 5</ls>. .²3 To separate, divide. .²4 To obstruct, interrupt. .²5 To neglect, omit, pass over; see व्यवहित also.
